rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACvetor
Exhibition name: American Hero ™
rows.Origin: Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, 2001).
rows.Bloom: Red. None to mild, sweet fragrance. 35 to 40 petals. Average diameter 2". Small, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, few or no prickles/thorns. Glossy foliage.

Height: 5' (150cm). Width: 4' (120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Heat tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
